title: column
intro:
A ’column’ is an one-dimensional vertical description of the soil/crop/atmosphere
system. The column component contains most of the other processes in Daisy as
submodels.
   < component (area 1 [m2 ])
                  (location) >

    area: number [m2 ]
     State variable (default 1)
     Area covered by this column. When logging multiple columns, the values are
     weighted by relative area.

    location: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
     Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
     Location of this column.

     The meaning depends on the number of point in the sequence. 0 points: The
     column has no specific location. 1 point: The column has a location, but no
     specific area. 3 or more points: The column represents the area specified by
     a polygon with the specified corner points.

        <    x y   >

        – x : number (dimension not specified)
          Parameter
          X-Coordinate.

        – y: number (dimension not specified)
          Parameter
          Y-Coordinate.

< default        (AWI AWI )                            ; Default Brusseau2023 value.
                   (Irrigation Irrigation )              ; Has default value.
                   (Soil Soil )                          ; Has partial value.
                   (SoilHeat SoilHeat )                  ; Has default value.
                   (SoilWater SoilWater )                ; Has default value.
                   (weather weather )
                   (scope scope )                        ; Default null value.
                   (second year utilization 0 [kg N/ha])
                   (Surface Surface )                    ; Default default value.
                   (SoilpH SoilpH )                      ; Default neutral value.
                   (Movement Movement )                  ; Default vertical value.
                   (Vegetation Vegetation )              ; Default crops value.
                   (Litter Litter )                      ; Default none value.
                   (Bioclimate Bioclimate )              ; Default default value.
                   (Drain Drain )                        ; Default none value.
                   (Groundwater Groundwater )
                   (Chemistry Chemistry )                ; Default nutrient value.
                   (OrganicMatter OrganicMatter )        ; Default SOM2025 value.
                   (tillage age tillage age ...)
                   ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 26.
                   (area 1 [m2 ])
                   (location) >

Component (default ‘Brusseau2023’)
        Air-water interface area.

attrs.name: Irrigation

Submodel (has fully specified default value)
        Active irrigation events.

attrs.name: Soil
attrs.doc:
Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        The numeric and physical soil properties.

attrs.name: SoilHeat
attrs.doc:
Submodel (has fully specified default value)

attrs.name: SoilWater

Submodel (has fully specified default value)

attrs.name: weather
attrs.doc:
Optional component
        Weather model for providing climate information during the simulation. If
        unspecified, used global weather.

attrs.name: scope
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘null’)
        Scope to evaluate expessions in.

attrs.name: second year utilization
attrs.doc: Estimated accumulated second year fertilizer effect.

attrs.name: Surface
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘default’)
    The upper border of the soil.

attrs.name: SoilpH
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘neutral’)
    The soil pH.

attrs.name: Movement
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘vertical’)

attrs.name: Vegetation
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘crops’)

attrs.name: Litter

Component (default ‘none’)
    The litter layer below the canopy.

attrs.name: Bioclimate
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘default’)
    The water and energy distribution among the crops.

attrs.name: Drain
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘none’)

attrs.name: Groundwater
attrs.doc: The groundwater level.

attrs.name: Chemistry

Component (default ‘nutrient’)

attrs.name: OrganicMatter
attrs.doc:
Component (default ‘SOM2025’)

attrs.name: tillage age
attrs.doc:
Time since the latest tillage operation was performed. By default, the top 25
    cm will have an initial tillage age of 100 days, while the soil below that will
    have an initial tillage age of 100 years. If you specify fewer values than there
    are soil cells, the last specified value will be used for the remaining cells.
Log Variables

attrs.name: first year utilization
attrs.doc: Estimated first year fertilizer effect.

attrs.name: yield DM
attrs.doc:
Amount of DM removed as yield this hour. This is the economic part of the
    storage organ, e.g. the grains.

attrs.name: yield N
attrs.doc:
Amount of nitrogen removed as yield this hour. This is the economic part of
    the storage organ, e.g. the grains.

attrs.name: harvest DM
attrs.doc: Amount of DM removed by harvest this hour.

attrs.name: harvest N
attrs.doc: Amount of nitrogen removed by harvest this hour.

attrs.name: harvest C
attrs.doc: Amount of carbon removed by harvest this hour.

attrs.name: residuals DM
attrs.doc:
Amount of dry matter removed from crops to surface and soil this hour. This
        includes loss as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves and roots.

attrs.name: residuals N top
attrs.doc:
Amount of nitrogen removed from crops to soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves.

attrs.name: residuals C top
attrs.doc:
Amount of carbon removed from crops to surface this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves.

attrs.name: residuals N soil
attrs.doc:
Amount of nitrogen removed from crops in soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.

attrs.name: residuals C soil
attrs.doc:
Amount of carbon removed from crops in soil this hour. This includes loss as
        harvest, as well as loss of old roots.

attrs.name: residuals N root
attrs.doc:
Amount of nitrogen removed from crops to soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.

attrs.name: residuals C root
attrs.doc:
Amount of carbon removed from crops to surface this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.

attrs.name: surface water
attrs.doc:
Amount of water in the system above ground. This include ponded water,
        intercepted water and the snow pack.

attrs.name: seed N
attrs.doc: Amount of nitrogen in seed applied this time step.

attrs.name: seed C
attrs.doc: Amount of carbon in seed applied this time step.

attrs.name: applied DM
attrs.doc:
Amount of dry matter applied this time step. This includes dry matter incor-
        porated directly in the soil.

sections.text:
Hansen et.al. 1990. with generic movement in soil.

  < default        (AWI AWI )                            ; Default Brusseau2023 value.
                   (Irrigation Irrigation )              ; Has default value.
                   (Soil Soil )                          ; Has partial value.
                   (SoilHeat SoilHeat )                  ; Has default value.
                   (SoilWater SoilWater )                ; Has default value.
                   (weather weather )
                   (scope scope )                        ; Default null value.
                   (second year utilization 0 [kg N/ha])
                   (Surface Surface )                    ; Default default value.
                   (SoilpH SoilpH )                      ; Default neutral value.
                   (Movement Movement )                  ; Default vertical value.
                   (Vegetation Vegetation )              ; Default crops value.
                   (Litter Litter )                      ; Default none value.
                   (Bioclimate Bioclimate )              ; Default default value.
                   (Drain Drain )                        ; Default none value.
                   (Groundwater Groundwater )
                   (Chemistry Chemistry )                ; Default nutrient value.
                   (OrganicMatter OrganicMatter )        ; Default SOM2025 value.
                   (tillage age tillage age ...)
                   ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 26.
                   (area 1 [m2 ])
                   (location) >

       AWI : AWI component (see chapter 9)
        Component (default ‘Brusseau2023’)
        Air-water interface area.

       Irrigation: Irrigation fixed component (see section 107.10)
        Submodel (has fully specified default value)
        Active irrigation events.

       Soil : Soil fixed component (see section 107.21)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        The numeric and physical soil properties.

       SoilHeat: SoilHeat fixed component (see section 107.22)
        Submodel (has fully specified default value)
        Soil heat capacity and transportation.

       SoilWater : SoilWater fixed component (see section 107.23)
        Submodel (has fully specified default value)
        Soil water content and transportation.

       weather : weather component (see chapter 103)
        Optional component
        Weather model for providing climate information during the simulation. If
        unspecified, used global weather.

       scope: scopesel component (see chapter 77)
        Component (default ‘null’)
        Scope to evaluate expessions in.

       second year utilization: number [kg N/ha]
        State variable (default 0)
        Estimated accumulated second year fertilizer effect.

   Surface: surface component (see chapter 87)
    Component (default ‘default’)
    The upper border of the soil.

   SoilpH : daisy/soil/soil.h component (see chapter 31)
    Component (default ‘neutral’)
    The soil pH.

   Movement: movement component (see chapter 56)
    Component (default ‘vertical’)
    Discretization and movement of water, heat and solutes in the soil.

   Vegetation: vegetation component (see chapter 100)
    Component (default ‘crops’)
    The crops on the field.

   Litter : litter component (see chapter 51)
    Component (default ‘none’)
    The litter layer below the canopy.

   Bioclimate: bioclimate component (see chapter 19)
    Component (default ‘default’)
    The water and energy distribution among the crops.

   Drain: drain component (see chapter 37)
    Component (default ‘none’)
    Drainage.

   Groundwater : groundwater component (see chapter 45)
    The groundwater level.

   Chemistry: chemistry component (see chapter 24)
    Component (default ‘nutrient’)
    Chemical compounds in the system.

   OrganicMatter : organic component (see chapter 60)
    Component (default ‘SOM2025’)
    The organic matter in the soil and on the surface.

   tillage age: number [d] soil cells
    Optional state variable
    Time since the latest tillage operation was performed. By default, the top 25
    cm will have an initial tillage age of 100 days, while the soil below that will
    have an initial tillage age of 100 years. If you specify fewer values than there
    are soil cells, the last specified value will be used for the remaining cells.

Log Variables
   first year utilization: number [kg N/ha/h]
    Estimated first year fertilizer effect.

   yield DM : number [g/m2 /h]
    Amount of DM removed as yield this hour. This is the economic part of the
    storage organ, e.g. the grains.

   yield N : number [g/m2 /h]
    Amount of nitrogen removed as yield this hour. This is the economic part of
    the storage organ, e.g. the grains.

       harvest DM : number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of DM removed by harvest this hour.
       harvest N : number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of nitrogen removed by harvest this hour.
       harvest C : number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of carbon removed by harvest this hour.
       residuals DM : number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of dry matter removed from crops to surface and soil this hour. This
        includes loss as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves and roots.
       residuals N top: number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of nitrogen removed from crops to soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves.

       residuals C top: number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of carbon removed from crops to surface this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old leaves.
       residuals N soil : number [g/cm3 /h] soil cells
        Amount of nitrogen removed from crops in soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.
       residuals C soil : number [g/cm3 /h] soil cells
        Amount of carbon removed from crops in soil this hour. This includes loss as
        harvest, as well as loss of old roots.
       residuals N root: number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of nitrogen removed from crops to soil this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.
       residuals C root: number [g/m2 /h]
        Amount of carbon removed from crops to surface this hour. This includes loss
        as harvest, as well as loss of old roots.

       surface water : number [mm]
        Amount of water in the system above ground. This include ponded water,
        intercepted water and the snow pack.
       seed N : number [kg N/ha/h]
        Amount of nitrogen in seed applied this time step.

       seed C : number [kg C/ha/h]
        Amount of carbon in seed applied this time step.
       applied DM : number [ton DM/ha/h]
        Amount of dry matter applied this time step. This includes dry matter incor-
        porated directly in the soil.
